curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate the role of legible handwriting in written communication.

interactions.prompt: Which note is easiest for a friend to read?
choices: C o m e h o m e.
interactions.feedback: Yes! Neat, well-spaced writing shares the message clearly.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the note with clear letters and spaces.

interactions.prompt: Choose two features of legible handwriting.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Clear shapes and spaces help readers.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what makes every word easy to see.

interactions.prompt: Sort each writing habit into Helps reading or Makes reading hard.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a habit, then its group.
interactions.feedback: Super sorting! Neat writing helps another person understand.
interactions.retryHint: Ask: could a friend read this quickly?

interactions.prompt: Why should you leave a space between 'my' and 'home'?
choices: So the reader sees two words
interactions.answer: So the reader sees two words
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Spaces show where one word ends and the next begins.
interactions.retryHint: A space separates words for the reader.

interactions.prompt: Build the clear message by choosing the neatly written words in order.
interactions.feedback: Lovely! Your clear message can be read and understood.
interactions.retryHint: Begin with My and keep one space between words.

interactions.prompt: What is the best reason to write legibly?
choices: Other people can read my message
interactions.answer: Other people can read my message
interactions.feedback: Wonderful! Legible handwriting makes written communication work.
interactions.retryHint: Writing communicates when another person can read it.
